snippet.title: Destroy The Moon - Game Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Moon is under attack. ARTEMIS-X is the last weapon left.

Destroy The Moon is a cosmic survivors-like where every upgrade brings you closer to becoming a living superweapon. Tear through alien swarms, evolve destructive abilities, rupture pocket dimensions, escape black holes, and stop the swarm from devouring the Moon. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4657890/Destroy_The_Moon/

Play the Steam Demo Now!

#Roguelike #IndieGame #DestroyTheMoon
